newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Q197 new car imports rise to 15,683.
newsitem.headline: Czech Q197 new car imports rise to 15,683.

text.p: Commercial imports of new passenger cars to the Czech Republic rose in the first quarter of this year to 15,683 from 13,169 a year earlier, the Czech Car Importers Association (CIA) said on Thursday.
Imports of light commercial vehicles rose to 3,275 from 2,612, the association said in a statement.
The figures do not include imports by individuals.
In March alone, passenger car imports rose to 6,562 from 5,142 a year earlier, an increase of 27.6 percent. Commercial vehicle imports in the month rose to 1,229 from 919, an increase of 34 percent.
Ford accounted for 15.5 percent of all imports in the first quarter, or 2,943 vehicles. General Motors unit Opel was second with 10.5 percent of imports or 1,984 vehicles.
Volkswagen was third with 10.0 percent or 1,902 cars and commercial vehicles, according to the association.
